description: Defines a SQL 'like' query to be run against the current grid.

where.description: Optional WHERE clause. There will be an implicit 'AND' between each provided filter.

groupBy.description: Optional GROUP BY clause. A list of one or more column names.

limit.description: Required. Limit of the number of rows returned to avoid loading more data than needed into your context window.

offset.description: Optional. specifies the offset of the first row to return.
